question: The total surface area of a solid right circular cylinder is 1617 cm². If the diameter of its base is 21 cm, then what is its volume (in cm³)? (Take π = 22/7)
solution:
Given:

The total surface area of a solid right circular cylinder is 1617 cm2.

The diameter of its base is 21 cm.

Concept used:

total surface area of a cylinder, A = 2πr(r+h) square units

The volume of the Cylinder, V = πr²h cubic units

Where ‘h’ is the height and ‘r’ is the radius.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8b63793955b1c97a051eee464372262a357269a9ba959dcf031809260153ea6.png] R

Calculation:

Let H be the height of the cylinder.

According to the question,

2π(21/2) × (21/2 + H) = 1617

⇒ (21/2 + H) = 24.5

⇒ H = 14

⇒ π(21/2)²H = 4851

**∴ The volume of the right cylinder is 4851 cm³**.
